correctness.rationale: All parameter domains and modulo-n orientations are fixed. The monomial-shift moduli are diagonal, so the upper-bound functional is exactly two max expressions. The internal maxima are the last nonwrap entry; F is strictly decreasing with explicitly opposite signs; G is strictly increasing; the postcrossing derivative is positive. The two cases therefore give unique global minima, with strict improvement for every n>=3. A full exact rational certificate shows the interior regime occurs at n=10,a=6/5,r=1; the n=3 case gives a unique quartic root. The independent finite consistency program is replayed from the packaged path and does not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The parent paper explicitly motivates theta optimization but proves only existence. Geometric cyclic shifts are canonical invertible monomial operators with a controlled growth-to-wrap structure. Exact minimizers, the n=2/n>=3 onset, and two genuinely occurring nonsmooth/smooth regimes give a complete all-dimension classification, not a sample gain. This supplies both a sharp analytic criterion and reproducing root calculations, with significance restricted to the bound being optimized.
